# Town of Panton municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 17; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Panton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk/Treasurer; 138 voters): Martha DeGraaf was elected moderator with 128 votes

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists the Panton selectboard: Zach Weaver (Chair), Teresa Boucher (Vice Chair), Kirsten De La Cruz, Robert Degraaf, and Reece Jaring

Town of Panton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk/Treasurer; 138 voters): Zachary Weaver was re-elected to a two-year seat with 122 votes and Robert T. DeGraaf to a three-year seat with 122 votes; Teresa Boucher, Kirsten De La Cruz, and Reece Jaring did not stand and continue
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Kyle Rowe as Panton's town clerk

Town of Panton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk/Treasurer; 138 voters): the return is certified by Kyle Rowe as Town Clerk/Treasurer; neither the clerk's nor the treasurer's office stood at the 2026 election
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Kyle Rowe as Panton's town treasurer
Town of Panton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk/Treasurer; 138 voters): the return is certified by Kyle Rowe as Town Clerk/Treasurer

Town of Panton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk/Treasurer; 138 voters): Charles Cushman was elected constable for a one-year term with 124 votes; the return styles the office simply 'Constable'

Town of Panton, 2025 Town Report, Town Officers table: the Panton Water District commissioners are three seats on staggered three-year terms: Chris Cook (term to 2028), Kathy Kennett (term to 2027), and John DeGraaf (term to 2026)

Town of Panton, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 town meeting (certified by the Town Clerk/Treasurer; 138 voters): John G. DeGraaf was re-elected water commissioner with 121 votes, on the town ballot voted by the whole checklist (general franchise)

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): Panton elects five justices of the peace; the listing names Gretchen Bailey, Eileen Brennan, James Dayton, Paula Moore, and Diane Raphael; the town report's variants ('Jamie Dayton', 'Diana Raphael') do not govern
